adversarial_audit.objection: Not measuring weak Fourier labels supplies useful cross-label phases.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False for mixed HSP coset states: inequivalent labels are exact direct-sum blocks, not a coherent superposition.

adversarial_audit.objection: The norm-one full power-map isometry makes every output block useful.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False for a source-label-preserving target: wrong labels are orthogonal leakage and cannot be reinterpreted as the desired carrier.

adversarial_audit.objection: This rules out any coherent use of the full quadrant expansion.
adversarial_audit.resolution: No. A recursion that combines all exponent terms before exposing labels is outside the theorem.

falsifiers_triggered: Source Plancherel amplitudes cannot be harvested as cross-irrep interference in a mixed coset state.
Retaining all power-map output labels preserves total norm but mostly produces wrong physical source sectors.
The only surviving power-map route must combine the full quadrant sum before label selection.

proof_obligations.resolution: Rejected: the physical source is an exact irrep-block mixture, the desired map preserves those blocks, and the Plancherel mean inverse normalization is superpolynomially small.
The term coefficients and exponent tuples must be combined by one structured recursion; label retention alone does not do it.
No end-to-end physical circuit or decoder is established.

summary: Keeping weak Fourier labels coherent does not repair the power-map normalization: physical coset states have exact irrep-label superselection, and Plancherel averaging leaves a superpolynomially small matching-block coefficient. The whole-quadrant recursion remains open.

theorem.coset_label_superselection: The mixed HSP coset state is |G|^-1 sum_(h in H) R_h and is exactly block diagonal in inequivalent QFT irrep labels.
theorem.cyclic_control: For C_m, retaining all Fourier labels restores total norm one but the mean mass in the matching physical block remains m^(-2k).
theorem.dimension_bound: S_3<=d_max|G|<=|G|^(3/2), so the mean is at most |G|^(-k+1/2).
theorem.plancherel_inverse_normalization_mean: For independent Plancherel labels, E[alpha^-2] equals S_3^(2k+1)/|G|^(4k+1).
theorem.scope: This rejects Plancherel label-coherence cancellation, not arbitrary label-mixing circuits, direct polars, or coherent whole-sum factorizations.
theorem.source_block_conservation: Every branch field J_h and candidate convolution C_Lambda acts within one fixed source-irrep tuple Lambda.
theorem.surviving_escape: A whole-quadrant FFT-like recursion may still combine exponent terms before any source-block selection.
theorem.wrong_block_interpretation: Other output-irrep blocks of the power-map isometry are orthogonal leakage, not coherent paths to the required Lambda-preserving output.
